title: 第一百零七章 尸湖
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

黑色的湖，没有波纹。

韩长老站在湖边，那张腐烂了一半的脸，在金尸散发出的微弱金光下，显得格外狰狞。他身上的道袍早已破烂不堪，露出下面青黑色的、如同岩石般坚硬的皮肤。他的身体僵硬，关节处发出“咔嚓、咔嚓”的摩擦声，像是一具生锈多年的机器，被强行启动了。

他看着金尸，喉咙里发出浑浊的咕噜声，那双浑浊的眼白，死死地盯着金尸那琥珀色的眼眸。

没有攻击。

也没有欢迎。

只是一种……迷茫。

仿佛在辨认一个早已被遗忘的、来自遥远过去的信号。

金尸停在了湖边，与韩长老隔着十几步的距离。

它没有说话，也没有动。只是静静地站着，像一座金色的灯塔，在这片死寂的黑暗中，散发着唯一的光和热。

林秋和王虎，躲在金尸身后，大气不敢出。

他们能感觉到，这个韩长老，和之前那个高高在上的执法堂长老，完全不同了。

如果说之前的韩长老是一把藏在鞘里的、冰冷的剑，那么现在的他，就是一具被掏空了灵魂、只剩下杀戮本能的、行尸走肉的傀儡。

而且，他身上的尸气，比湖水的味道还要浓烈，还要阴冷。

“陈默师兄……”林秋颤抖着，拉了拉金尸那粗糙的衣角，“他……他好像还有一点意识。”

金尸微微低头，看了林秋一眼。

然后，它做了一件让所有人都意想不到的事。

它松开了抱着那些“垃圾”的手。

那些捡来的、破碎的玉佩、鞋子、锄头，哗啦啦地，掉在了地上。

金尸，空着手，一步一步，走向了韩长老。

每走一步，它身上的金光，就暗淡一分。

每走一步，它那沙砾构成的躯体，就仿佛被湖水的死气腐蚀，变得透明了一分。

它在消耗自己。

韩长老似乎被激怒了。

这个闯入者，竟然敢空着手走向他！

这是对他的蔑视！

“吼——！”

韩长老发出一声低沉的咆哮，那声音不像人声，更像是野兽的嘶吼。他猛地一跺脚，坚硬的地面瞬间龟裂。他像一颗炮弹，朝着金尸，扑了过来！

速度快得惊人！

林秋和王虎，甚至没看清他的动作，只看到一道黑影，带着腥风，已经到了金尸面前！

韩长老那只青黑色的、指甲足有半尺长的爪子，直取金尸的胸口！

这一爪，要是抓实了，别说金尸这沙砾构成的身体，就是精钢，也要被掏出一个洞来！

金尸没有躲。

它只是抬起了一只手。

“砰！”

韩长老的爪子，抓在了金尸的手掌上。

没有想象中的能量碰撞，只有一声沉闷的、如同败革被撕裂的声响。

金尸的身体，猛地一震。

它那沙砾构成的手掌，瞬间出现了无数细小的裂纹，黑色的死气，顺着裂纹，疯狂地向上蔓延，试图侵蚀金尸的整个手臂。

但金尸，没有退。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Black lake, no ripples.

Elder Han stood by the lake, his half-rotted face looking particularly ferocious under the faint golden light emitted by the golden corpse.The Taoist robe on his body was already in tatters, revealing the blue-black, rock-hard skin underneath.His body was stiff, and his joints made "clicking, clicking" friction sounds, like a machine that had been rusty for many years and was forcibly started.

He looked at the golden corpse, a muddy gurgling sound came from his throat, and the whites of his muddy eyes stared intently at the amber eyes of the golden corpse.

No attack.

There was no welcome either.

Just kind of...confused.

It was as if he was recognizing a long-forgotten signal from the distant past.

The golden corpse stopped by the lake, more than ten steps away from Elder Han.

It didn't speak or move.Just standing quietly, like a golden lighthouse, emitting the only light and heat in this dead darkness.

Lin Qiu and Wang Hu hid behind the golden corpse, not daring to show their anger.

They could feel that this Elder Han was completely different from the previous aloof Law Enforcement Hall elder.

If the previous Elder Han was a cold sword hidden in a sheath, then he is now a walking zombie with his soul hollowed out and only the killing instinct left.

Moreover, the corpse aura on his body was stronger and colder than the smell of the lake water.

"Senior Brother Chen Mo..." Lin Qiu trembled and tugged on the rough clothes of the golden corpse, "He... he seems to still have some consciousness."

The golden corpse lowered his head slightly and glanced at Lin Qiu.

Then, it did something that everyone expected.

It loosened its grip on the "junk".

The picked up and broken jade pendants, shoes, and hoes fell to the ground with a clatter.

The golden corpse walked towards Elder Han step by step with empty hands.

With every step it took, the golden light on its body dimmed a little.

With every step it took, its body made of gravel seemed to be corroded by the dead air of the lake and became a little more transparent.

It's consuming itself.

Elder Han seemed to be irritated.

This intruder actually dared to walk towards him empty-handed!

This is contempt for him!

"Ho--!"

Elder Han let out a low roar. The sound did not sound like a human voice, but more like the roar of a wild beast.He stamped his foot suddenly, and the hard ground cracked instantly.He rushed towards the golden corpse like a cannonball!

The speed is amazing!

Lin Qiu and Wang Hu didn't even see his movements clearly. They only saw a black shadow with a fishy wind coming to the golden corpse!

Elder Han's green-black claws, with nails half a foot long, reached straight for the golden corpse's chest!

If this claw is grasped firmly, a hole will be dug out of the golden corpse's body made of sand and gravel, even if it is made of fine steel!

The golden corpse did not hide.

It just raised a hand.

"Bang!"

Elder Han's claws caught the golden corpse's palm.

There was no energy collision as expected, only a dull sound, like the sound of defeated leather being torn apart.

The body of the golden corpse shook violently.

Countless tiny cracks instantly appeared on its palm made of gravel, and the black death energy spread crazily upward along the cracks, trying to erode the entire arm of the golden corpse.

But the golden corpse did not retreat.
